The City of Fruita's draft budget for 2027 is a 332-page PDF.
This explorer lets you tap through it instead: where the money comes from, where it goes, what changes on your bills, and answers to common questions.
Every number shows the budget page it came from, and the page number opens the city's PDF.

::: {.ftw-buttons}
[<i class="bi bi-bar-chart-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i> Open the explorer](v2/)
:::

::: {.ftw-callout .ftw-callout-info}
### <i class="bi bi-robot" aria-hidden="true"></i> Built with AI from a draft budget

I built this explorer with AI, working from the City Manager's Recommended 2027 Budget, a draft dated November 12, 2026.
AI can get things wrong, so check anything important against the budget page it cites.

City staff haven't reviewed it, and the City of Fruita doesn't endorse it.
For official figures, see the city's [2027 Annual Budget page](https://www.fruita.org/810/2027-Annual-Budget).

City Council usually adopts the budget in early December and may change it.
I'll post new versions as the budget changes.
:::

This isn't one of my Fruita Tech Wizard services, just a side project for my neighbors.
If you spot a mistake, please [email me](mailto:help@fruitatechwizard.com).

## Versions

Each version stays here, so you can see how the numbers changed.
The newest is at the top.

::: {.ftw-card .ftw-version}
### Version 2 (latest)

Posted November 16, 2026.
Based on the same draft budget, dated November 12, 2026.
The budget numbers haven't changed.

- Page numbers now open the city's budget PDF to that page.
- Links to the city's budget page and the full budget PDF.
- "Money in" is now a box chart you can tap into, like "Money out".
- Easier to read on phones, with "Next" links between tabs.
